subject: Intro request: AWS co-sell intake for Arbour Health
messages:
From: Amelia Ruiz <amelia.ruiz@arbourhealth.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Devon Patel <devon.patel@arbourhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS co-sell intro request — Arbour + Redwood

Hi Rachel,

Hope you’re doing well. Quick note from Arbour — we’re evaluating vendors for a HIPAA-friendly LLM inference layer and our AWS partner team recommended Redwood for a co-sell introduction. Devon (cc'd) is the technical lead; we also expect procurement involvement next week.

High-level asks:
- Intro to Redwood for an AWS co-sell intake
- Outline of mutual action plan (procurement + security checkpoints)
- Proposed 30/60/90 goals for a pilot on EKS with dedicated capacity

Are you available for a 30-minute intro on Thursday or Friday this week? Preferred time windows: Thu 10–12 PT or Fri 9–11 PT.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Amelia Ruiz
Head of Platform Partnerships
Arbour Health
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: arbour_salesdeck.pdf (slide deck, 7 pages)

From: rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com
To: Amelia Ruiz <amelia.ruiz@arbourhealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS co-sell intro request — Arbour + Redwood

Amelia — great to meet you by email. Thanks for the context and the deck. We’d be happy to run a co-sell intake and align on a mutual action plan.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-minute intro with Redwood solution + AWS partner (we can host) — I can do Fri 9:30 PT.
2) I'll share a short MA Plan template (roles, milestones, procurement gating items).
3) Security prerequisites: SOC2 summary and evidence points — we can attach a short summary ahead of the call.

Karthik (cc) runs our AWS co-sell and will join the meeting and loop in the AWS TAM where useful. Lauren (cc) will own the MA Plan and follow-up items.

Could you confirm Fri 9:30 PT works and who from procurement should join?

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive — AWS GTM
Redwood Inference

Attachment: (will attach MA plan template + SOC2 summary before the call)

Perfect — confirmed for Fri 9:30 PT (30 min). Calendar invite sent.

I attached the MA Plan draft and our SOC2 summary for procurement review. Quick pre-read highlights:
- Pilot scope: up to 3 dedicated GPUs, 30M inference tokens, 3-month timeline.
- Security: SOC2 type II scope, encryption at rest, optional VPC peering for private deployments.
- Procurement: typical SOW + Net30 PO; we included a sample pricing band for a pilot and an estimated onboarding timeline (2 weeks).

Attachments: AWS_Mutual_Action_Plan_draft.xlsx, SOC2_summary.pdf

On the call we'll cover: technical scope, success metrics, procurement runway, and AWS TAM involvement. If Mary wants any additional artifacts before the call, flag them and Lauren will follow up.

Thanks all — see you tomorrow.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive — AWS GTM
Redwood Inference
